structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "TRUMP / American Patriot" launched through pump.fun. Its pool on PumpSwap opened with the token, so it has no bonding-curve history. It is 12.6 minutes old, at about $200k market cap with $40k liquidity. In that time it traded about $320k with roughly 4.3 buys per sell and about 2,100 unique buyers against 266 unique sellers. Price is up 128%, including +41% in the last 5 minutes. The launch came with a website, a Telegram, a DexScreener profile and 30 active paid boosts. The project's X account has been renamed 4 times (murphTokenonSol, TrollAlienSol, mandate_base, now patriot_trump_x).

narrative.description: A generic Trump/patriot meme using the heavily recycled TRUMP ticker. The packet shows no specific trigger event. The description is boilerplate: 'Inspired by American patriotic imagery'.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely paid launch promotion (30 DexScreener boosts, a pre-built site and TG, a recycled X account) plus the usual Trump-ticker speculation, not an organic story.

token_connection.why_this_token: Nothing marks this as the canonical coin. It is one of many TRUMP-ticker copies, and its only difference is the newly branded name 'American Patriot'.
token_connection.competing_tokens: OFFICIAL TRUMP (6p6x..., $418M), 'OFFER TRUTH' TRUMP ($1.8B listed), TRUMP (TMPK..., $3.5M), MAGA Wormhole, and dead TRUMP COIN copies.

authenticity.evidence: The DexScreener boosts (30), the profile update, and a site and TG ready at launch all point to an organised team launch. The X account has been recycled through 4 memecoin identities, which suggests a serial-launch operator. The top 10 holders each hold almost exactly 0.25-0.26%, a very uniform pattern consistent with supply split across many wallets. GMGN flags 13 sniper, 6 bundler and 26 fresh wallets, but their rates are low. There are only 2 smart wallets, and smart-money signals and KOL calls are both zero.
authenticity.uncertainty: The unique-buyer count (2,113) is large and could be real retail drawn in by the boosts. Without on-chain wallet clustering, I can't tell whether the evenly sized holders are a dev farm or just equal-sized bot or retail buys.

structural_risks: The X account has been recycled 4 times, which points to a serial launcher who has likely dumped before
The uniform ~0.26% top holders may be dev supply hidden across many wallets
The LP is burned, so liquidity can't be pulled, but a coordinated sell-off is still possible
Liquidity-to-market-cap is about 20%, so large sells hit the price hard
The generic TRUMP ticker has no claim to being the canonical coin
The rally is driven by paid boosts, so it may fade once promotion stops
The creator's best previous token peaked at about $233k ATH, roughly the current level

structured_output.counterargument: This could be exactly the kind of well-funded, organised launch that runs. It already has 2,100+ unique buyers in 13 minutes, buyers outnumber sellers about 8 to 1, momentum is accelerating (m5 rate 3.4x the h1 rate), mint and freeze are renounced, the LP is burned, and RugCheck finds no risks. Heavy boost spending means the team has an incentive to push the market cap well past $400k before selling, so a 2x from about $200-250k could come within the first hour.
unknowns: The real X post activity and whether any KOLs are promoting the coin

structured_output.thesis: This is a professionally promoted launch with strong short-term flow: very broad buyer counts and heavy buy pressure. It also carries serial-launcher red flags: a recycled X account, heavy paid boosts, a suspiciously uniform holder distribution and a generic TRUMP ticker. The momentum gives it a better-than-typical shot at a quick 2x from about $200k. Entry comes after a +128% move, though, and teams like this usually sell into the boosts, so a fall of 50% or more is also very likely. I rate it slightly above the pool's base rate for running, with elevated rug/dump risk.
